answer_1.quote: We train a gloss-to-text sign language translation transformer (Yin and Read, 2020b) on both datasets. On RWTH-PHOENIX-Weather 2014T, we obtain 22.17 BLEU on testing; on Public DGS Corpus, we obtain a mere 3.2 BLEU.
